description: Live E2E for the Dialogic RQL module. Driven by scripts/extension_e2e.py (via scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor (with the pinned third-party Dialogic addon installed from extension.json testAddon and its Dialogic autoload registered) and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module (source, rows, creation calls, guide) turns the suite red.
notes: No 'setup' scene: Dialogic works on res:// resource files (.dtl timelines, .dch characters), not scene nodes. rql-schema proves the module was discovered (its source). The 'tools' then run every DialogicGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise) on the former paths res://e2e_intro.dtl and res://e2e_hero.dch, followed by read-backs (the character through a fresh godot.resource load too) and rejected calls. 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON: rows are '|'-separated.

input.query: dialogic.timelines | where name == "e2e_intro" | call AddText("A second line", "Hero")
dialogic.characters | where name == "e2e_hero" | get resource | set props["description"] = "The bravest hero."
dialogic.characters | select path displayName color description

expect: color must be a hex color
